AffixValueRange.description:
What an affix adds at one rarity, by the level it rolled: Placebo's StepFunction in its bounds form. Placebo
refuses a range that is not a whole number of steps, and min equal to max: a fixed value is a plain number.

max.description: The value at the highest roll.
max.title: Max

min.description: The value at the lowest roll.
min.title: Min

step.description: The values between go up by this much.
step.title: Step

AffixValueRange.title: AffixValueRange

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description:
An affix of our own (RLM-557), a new entry where Apotheosis looks for affixes of any namespace: the stat it adds
per rarity, the loot categories of ours it rolls on, its name and its suffix. It is an ``apotheosis:attribute``
affix of the ``stat`` kind, the one kind Apotheosis's own format covers without code. An item that rolls it is
named by it: "Sorcerous Netherite Robes of Winter" (``name`` for one affix, ``suffix`` for another).

categories.description: The loot categories it rolls on, each one of ours, e.g. realmforge:robe_chest.

items.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

categories.title: Categories

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

name.description: The word before an item's name, e.g. Sorcerous.

quality.description: How much a player's luck raises its weight (Apotheosis's stat affixes: 0.1).
quality.title: Quality

stat.description: The stat it adds, one of ours (content/stats/), e.g. realmforge:spell_power.
stat.title: Stat

suffix.description: The words after an item's name, e.g. of Sorcery.

values.description: Rarity -> what it adds there, added to the stat as a flat amount (add_value): {min, max, step} or a fixed number. A share is a fraction: 3 % is 0.03. It rolls only at the rarities listed.

propertyNames.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

values.title: Values

weight.description: How often it rolls against the others (Apotheosis's stat affixes: 25).
weight.title: Weight
